title: Statistical Inference for Adversarial Training: Central Limit Theorems via Optimal Transport
summary: The purpose of this paper is to rigorously quantify the statistical and learning-theoretic properties of adversarial training models for classification. Equivalently, we establish the statistical properties of empirical optimal partial transport. Precisely, first we provide two types of central limit theorems (CLT): CLT centered at the expected empirical value, and CLT centered at the population one with smoothing.
